brief: @buildthis.bisks.net create a site with a poll with options to assign LLM models to each character that belongs to the Fellowship of the Ring (the nine). People log in and vote
note: built fellowshipcast.bisks.net — sign in with Bluesky, cast an LLM for each of the nine walkers, watch the network-wide tally update live. no server, just your own PDS.
